subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Should Sessions sorting use a read-time meaningful-activity projection, a persisted activity/rollup field, or keep `updatedAt` ordering with narrower UI improvements?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the activity taxonomy, parent/child rollup semantics, and stable `sessions.list` contract shape are product/API choices that automation should not decide.

options.title: Prefer read-time projection
options.body: Derive `lastMeaningfulActivityAt` and a reason label from a capped recent-events/transcript tail so noisy background paths do not constantly rewrite parent session rows.

options.title: Persist activity fields
options.body: Add stored activity fields and parent rollup with explicit migration, write-amplification limits, and tests for noisy heartbeat/cron/sub-agent traffic.

options.title: Keep updatedAt for now
options.body: Leave ordering unchanged and pursue narrower display improvements while collecting more evidence about the event taxonomy users need.

recommendation.title: Prefer read-time projection
recommendation.body: Derive `lastMeaningfulActivityAt` and a reason label from a capped recent-events/transcript tail so noisy background paths do not constantly rewrite parent session rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current ownership signal is recent work on the Gateway session-list projection and session row contract that this decision would change.
